info.name: Cassandra's Latest Information
info.parent: Snow Silk and the Mysterious Fabric

descriptions.notStarted: Cassandra, maple world's informant, is said to have obtained some new information hot off the press.  I'm curious what it is.
descriptions.inProgress: Cassandra told me about the Snow Silk.  But for some reason she wouldn't explain in detail and kept telling me to just go see the archaeologist, #bWinston#k...
descriptions.completed: Maple world's informant, Cassandra, notified me of her latest information, the Snow Silk.  I went to go see Winston, the archaeologist who is looking for this Snow Silk.
